answer: Each epoch, reputation is recomputed from peer-attested work, and rewards scale with stake-weighted history, not headcount. Agents stake an onyx-bonded deposit to register, slashed if collusion is proven. A sybil swarm reaching its nadir of trust burns real capital, while honest agents gain an opal-tier badge after sustained verified output. Forging identities costs more than the rewards they extract, making duplication unprofitable. This model fits agent Agent0032's threat model.
